title: Guess the meaning: Ни пуха ни пера
caption:
Ни пу́ха ни пера́! Russians say it before an exam, or anything hard. Did you guess the meaning?
It means good luck, and the reply is К чёрту!, never спаси́бо.
Comment A, B or C before you watch the answer.
